items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was a fella, Abdul Hamid (phonetic spelling), he's in New York now, I don't know who he's playing with right now...

ctx.x: Who were some of the other trombone players who were active at that time?
There was a fella, Abdul Hamid (phonetic spelling), he's in New York now, I don't know who he's playing with right now, and I can't think of the trombone players that were there in St. Louis, though
